description: QBR Narrator Agent — CS Tool Registry bridge. This file is the machine-readable mirror of the pipeline's CS Tool Registry scoped to this agent. It is generated from engine/integrations.py and is read by the no-code Connector Dashboard. End users never edit this file by hand — they use the dashboard toggles. Tools marked 'watch' have no usable no-code integration surface and are NOT wired.

ai_services.name: Anthropic Claude
ai_services.category: LLM — deck text, translation & tone analysis
ai_services.note: Requires Build Tier 1 prepaid API credit ($5 min) — an API key, not a Claude Pro subscription.

ai_services.name: ElevenLabs
ai_services.note: Requires Starter plan ($5/mo) or higher to unlock Instant Voice Cloning and commercial voice generation.
